name: Demetrius I Poliorcetes
contribution: A Macedonian Greek nobleman and military leader who became king of Asia between 306 and 301 BC, and king of Macedon between 294 and 288 BC.
legacy: In 307 BC, this person successfully ousted Cassander's governor of Athens and after defeating Ptolemy I at the Battle of Salamis he gave his father the title of basileus over a land spanning from the Aegean Sea to the Middle East.

checks.lead: Demetrius I Poliorcetes (; Greek: Δημήτριος Πολιορκητής, Dēmḗtrios Poliorkētḗs, lit. 'the Besieger of Cities'; 337–283 BC) was a Macedonian Greek nobleman and military leader who became king of Asia between 306 and 301 BC, and king of Macedon between 294 and 288 BC. A member of the Antigonid dynasty, he was the son of its founder, Antigonus I Monophthalmus, and his wife Stratonice, as well as the first member of the family to rule Macedon in Hellenistic Greece.
